decisions.reason: The electronic music box lies outside the firm's wooden core and likely carries higher keeping costs, so with no evidence of strong demand after one season, real options reasoning suggests abandoning this option.
The wooden nativity stable fits the firm's established product range and distribution channels, and keeping this option open costs little while demand uncertainty remains.
The modern incense smoker is an exploratory option with high uncertainty about market acceptance, and its low keeping cost makes it worthwhile to retain until more demand information resolves.
